description: Application view model for user activity summary data (not stored as a database table).
business_purpose: Used to track and report user activity summary records for the General area.
record_granularity: One object represents one user activity summary result row.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the user activity summary.

columns.name: FullName
columns.description: Full name of the user activity summary.

columns.name: days_made_calls
columns.description: Days made calls of the user activity summary.

columns.name: leave_days
columns.description: Leave days of the user activity summary.

columns.name: official_work_days
columns.description: Official work days of the user activity summary.

columns.name: avg_calls_per_day
columns.description: Avg calls per day of the user activity summary.

columns.name: working_days
columns.description: Working days of the user activity summary.

business_rules: UserActivitySummary is an application view model or report DTO populated in code, not a table stored in the database.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against UserActivitySummary: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting user activity summary records; joins can duplicate rows.
Populated in application code (for example from a stored procedure or joined query); query the underlying tables instead.
